verdict.rationale: pnpm's GitHub README explicitly states it "works everywhere" and supports Windows, Linux, and macOS. Its self-contained executable, per-project Node.js pinning, and file-based config (pnpm-workspace.yaml with ${ENV} substitution) support a consistent workflow across machines. One community report describes `pnpx create` scripts exiting without prompts in Windows Terminal, a minor platform-specific rough edge rather than a contradiction. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on cross-platform behavior (e.g. Windows symlink/hard-link handling), explicit evidence that identical config behaves the same on each OS, independent corroboration of smooth Windows use.
